system: Prinz-Marder stomatogastric pyloric model population (crustacean), 31 conductances
stiff_summary: leak conductances (AB/PD, LP, PY) + graded inhibitory synapses
sloppy_summary: fast voltage-gated Na (PY.Na, AB/PD.Na, LP.Na) + delayed-rectifier Kd
cross_system_convergence: Fast voltage-gated inward currents are the sloppy axis in BOTH systems: Na in the crustacean STG and Ca (EGL-19, UNC-2) in the C. elegans whole-organism model (Supplementary S5.2). Leak/passive and network coupling are stiff in both. The behavioural/output-equivalence manifold's sloppy directions are the same biophysical class across phyla -> the stiff/sloppy geometry is mechanism-conserved, not model-specific.
